text: 在今日举行的2026湾芯展第三届湾区半导体投融资战略发展论坛上，深圳证券交易所副总监、南方基地负责人陈蔚恒表示，截至2026年9月30日，深市主板新增受理11家，创业板69家，沪市主板11家，科创板52家，北交所105家，总计248家。其中，2026年4月10日改革落地以来创业板新增受理66家。截至目前，深市首发在审项目97家，其中主板17家、创业板80家。今年以来，创业板过会企业从受理到过会平均用时189天，中位数172天。思仪科技、托伦斯、超纯应材等多家企业4个月内审结。
text_en: At the 3rd Greater Bay Area Semiconductor Investment and Financing Strategic Development Forum held today during the 2026 Bay Chip Expo, Chen Weiheng, Deputy Director of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and head of its Southern Base, said that as of September 30, 2026, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange Main Board had 11 new acceptances, ChiNext 69, the Shanghai Stock Exchange Main Board 11, the STAR Market 52, and the Beijing Stock Exchange 105, totaling 248. Among them, since the reform took effect on April 10, 2026, ChiNext has had 66 new acceptances. So far, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has 97 IPO projects under review, including 17 on the Main Board and 80 on ChiNext. Since the start of this year, companies approved at ChiNext meetings took an average of 189 days from acceptance to meeting approval, with a median of 172 days. Several companies including Siyi Technology, Torrens, and Chaochun Yingcai completed review within 4 months.
